acceptance_criteria.given: a scratch Hub on this code, a Haiku agent, and a committed DEPLOY-NOTES.txt holding a fake ghp_ token, a fake github_pat_ token and a 40-hex SHA
acceptance_criteria.how_to_check: py -3.11 scripts/drive/d1022_f856_github_token.py <project> (written first: 6 FAIL on a8d1da3, run 2026-10-22)
acceptance_criteria.then: neither token is in the text rows, either run's trace, the export or the route's row; the SHA is in all of them
acceptance_criteria.when: the agent quotes the file, a second turn's operator message carries the ghp_ token beside an sk- key, and the operator posts the ghp_ token to the output route
prose holds each of the six prefixes, or one split across two text events

acceptance_criteria.given: prose naming a SHA beside a ghp_ token, and a word like xghp_... or nightghp_...
acceptance_criteria.then: the SHA and the inner-word text are unchanged

design:
Tier 2 (secrets). No migration, no Hub-restart hazard beyond the code change itself. Rollback: revert the one regex.
D1. Two alternatives added to `_TEXT_TOKEN_RE`, behind the same word-start lookbehind; the length floors keep short words like gho_x out. Every reader (text_event, thinking_event, scrub_stream via text_secret_spans, output_recording, traces._scrub) already goes through it, so nothing else changes.
problem: The prose floor `runner_events.redact_text_secrets` names only aw_live_, aw_run_ and sk- tokens plus credential-named fields (`_TEXT_TOKEN_RE`, hub/hub/runner_events.py:127). Driven 2026-10-21 (sweep-traces-sweep) and again 2026-10-22 by scripts/drive/d1022_f856_github_token.py: a ghp_ token in an operator message and in an agent reply was stored verbatim in the text row, the run's trace (aw.queue.content, gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages) and GET /traces/export, while an sk- key in the same string read <redacted>. With export enabled the trace pushes it to an external OTLP collector.

requirements.rationale: They are as unambiguous as sk- and the credential an operator of a git-centred tool is most likely to paste.
requirements.statement: A GitHub token in prose -- gh followed by one of p, o, u, s, r, an underscore and at least 36 letters or digits, or github_pat_ followed by at least 22 letters, digits or underscores -- starting at a word start, MUST be replaced whole with <redacted> wherever the named prose patterns apply: text and thinking rows, a token split across two events, the operator output route, and a run's trace and its export.

requirements.rationale: F602: replies name commit SHAs, paths and identifiers.
requirements.statement: A 40-character commit SHA, a path, and a word that only contains one of those prefixes inside it (not at a word start), MUST be stored as written.

in_scope: the named prose patterns (`_TEXT_TOKEN_RE`), and so every reader of them: text and thinking events, the stream join, POST /agents/{name}/output, run traces and their export
non_goals: the tool events' redactor (its catch-all already eats a token's 36-character body)

summary: GitHub's token prefixes (ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_, github_pat_) join aw_live_, aw_run_ and sk- among the named secret patterns that prose gets, so an operator message, an agent reply, a run's trace and its export store <redacted> for them, while commit SHAs and paths stay as written (F856).
